options.doc: Control the rendering of line numbers. If it is a function, it will be invoked when rendering a line number and the return value will be rendered. options.doc: Controls the minimal number of visible leading and trailing lines surrounding the cursor. Defaults to 0.

options.name: unusualLineTerminators
options.doc: Remove unusual line terminators like LINE SEPARATOR (LS), PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR (PS). Defaults to 'prompt'.

options.name: selectOnLineNumbers
options.doc: Should the corresponding line be selected when clicking on the line number? Defaults to true.

options.name: lineNumbersMinChars
options.doc: Control the width of line numbers, by reserving horizontal space for rendering at least an amount of digits. Defaults to 5.

options.name: glyphMargin

options.doc: The width reserved for line decorations (in px). Line decorations are placed between line numbers and the editor content. You can pass in a string in the format floating point followed by "ch". e.g. 1.3ch. Defaults to 10.

options.doc: Control the wrapping of the editor. When `wordWrap` = "off", the lines will never wrap. When `wordWrap` = "on", the lines will wrap at the viewport width. options.name: wordWrapOverride1
options.doc: Override the `wordWrap` setting.

options.name: wordWrapOverride2
options.doc: Override the `wordWrapOverride1` setting.

options.name: wordWrapColumn
options.doc: Control the wrapping of the editor. When `wordWrap` = "off", the lines will never wrap. When `wordWrap` = "on", the lines will wrap at the viewport width. When `wordWrap` = "wordWrapColumn", the lines will wrap at `wordWrapColumn`. When `wordWrap` = "bounded", the lines will wrap at min(viewport width, wordWrapColumn). Defaults to 80.

options.name: wrappingIndent
options.doc: Control indentation of wrapped lines. Can be: 'none', 'same', 'indent' or 'deepIndent'. Defaults to 'same' in vscode and to 'none' in monaco-editor.

options.name: wrappingStrategy

options.name: wordWrapBreakAfterCharacters
options.doc: Configure word wrapping characters. A break will be introduced after these characters.

options.doc: Sets whether line breaks appear wherever the text would otherwise overflow its content box. When wordBreak = 'normal', Use the default line break rule. When wordBreak = 'keepAll', Word breaks should not be used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text. Non-CJK text behavior is the same as for normal.

options.name: guides
options.doc: Controls the behavior of editor guides.

members.name: bracketPairs
members.doc: Enable rendering of bracket pair guides. Defaults to false.

members.name: bracketPairsHorizontal
members.doc: Enable rendering of vertical bracket pair guides. Defaults to 'active'.

members.name: highlightActiveBracketPair
members.doc: Enable highlighting of the active bracket pair. Defaults to true.

members.name: indentation
members.doc: Enable rendering of indent guides. Defaults to true.

members.name: highlightActiveIndentation
members.doc: Enable highlighting of the active indent guide. Defaults to true.

options.name: unicodeHighlight
options.doc: Controls the behavior of the unicode highlight feature (by default, ambiguous and invisible characters are highlighted).

members.name: nonBasicASCII
members.doc: Controls whether all non-basic ASCII characters are highlighted. Only characters between U+0020 and U+007E, tab, line-feed and carriage-return are considered basic ASCII.

members.name: invisibleCharacters
members.doc: Controls whether characters that just reserve space or have no width at all are highlighted.

members.name: ambiguousCharacters
members.doc: Controls whether characters are highlighted that can be confused with basic ASCII characters, except those that are common in the current user locale.

members.name: includeComments
members.doc: Controls whether characters in comments should also be subject to unicode highlighting.

members.name: includeStrings
members.doc: Controls whether characters in strings should also be subject to unicode highlighting.

members.name: allowedCharacters
members.doc: Defines allowed characters that are not being highlighted.

members.name: allowedLocales
members.doc: Unicode characters that are common in allowed locales are not being highlighted.

options.name: bracketPairColorization
options.doc: Configures bracket pair colorization (disabled by default).

members.name: enabled
members.doc: Enable or disable bracket pair colorization.

members.name: independentColorPoolPerBracketType
members.doc: Use independent color pool per bracket type.

options.name: dropIntoEditor
options.doc: Controls dropping into the editor from an external source. When enabled, this shows a preview of the drop location and triggers an `onDropIntoEditor` event.

members.name: enabled
members.doc: Enable dropping into editor. Defaults to true.

members.name: showDropSelector
members.doc: Controls if a widget is shown after a drop. Defaults to 'afterDrop'.

options.name: editContext
options.doc: Sets whether the new experimental edit context should be used instead of the text area.

options.name: renderRichScreenReaderContent
options.doc: Controls whether to render rich HTML screen reader content when the EditContext is enabled

options.name: pasteAs
options.doc: Controls support for changing how content is pasted into the editor.

members.name: enabled
members.doc: Enable paste as functionality in editors. Defaults to true.

members.name: showPasteSelector
members.doc: Controls if a widget is shown after a drop. Defaults to 'afterPaste'.

options.name: tabFocusMode
options.doc: Controls whether the editor / terminal receives tabs or defers them to the workbench for navigation.

options.name: inlineCompletionsAccessibilityVerbose
options.doc: Controls whether the accessibility hint should be provided to screen reader users when an inline completion is shown.

options.name: tabSize
options.doc: The number of spaces a tab is equal to. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `detectIndentation` is on. Defaults to 4.

options.name: insertSpaces
options.doc: Insert spaces when pressing `Tab`. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `detectIndentation` is on. Defaults to true.

options.name: detectIndentation
options.doc: Controls whether `tabSize` and `insertSpaces` will be automatically detected when a file is opened based on the file contents. Defaults to true.

options.name: trimAutoWhitespace
options.doc: Remove trailing auto inserted whitespace. Defaults to true.

options.name: largeFileOptimizations
options.doc: Special handling for large files to disable certain memory intensive features. Defaults to true.

options.name: wordBasedSuggestions
options.doc: Controls whether completions should be computed based on words in the document. Defaults to true.

options.name: wordBasedSuggestionsOnlySameLanguage
options.doc: Controls whether word based completions should be included from opened documents of the same language or any language.

options.name: semanticHighlighting.enabled
options.doc: Controls whether the semanticHighlighting is shown for the languages that support it. true: semanticHighlighting is enabled for all themes false: semanticHighlighting is disabled for all themes 'configuredByTheme': semanticHighlighting is controlled by the current color theme's semanticHighlighting setting. Defaults to 'byTheme'.

options.name: stablePeek
options.doc: Keep peek editors open even when double-clicking their content or when hitting `Escape`. Defaults to false.

options.name: maxTokenizationLineLength
options.doc: Lines above this length will not be tokenized for performance reasons. Defaults to 20000.

options.name: theme
options.doc: Theme to be used for rendering. The current out-of-the-box available themes are: 'vs' (default), 'vs-dark', 'hc-black', 'hc-light'. You can create custom themes via `monaco.editor.defineTheme`. To switch a theme, use `monaco.editor.setTheme`. **NOTE**: The theme might be overwritten if the OS is in high contrast mode, unless `autoDetectHighContrast` is set to false.

options.name: autoDetectHighContrast
options.doc: If enabled, will automatically change to high contrast theme if the OS is using a high contrast theme. Defaults to true.
